prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change kinds, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have at least two tests.
sign_in hint, home new_flow, choose_path layout, and adoption new_flow can be helpful change types since each produced at least one winning test.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes did not work, showing no clear effect or worse performance across all tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall across most onboarding tests.
Predictions consistently underestimated actual performance for home new_flow and winning sign_in hint tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Safeguard Sign-In Hint: Add a clear account security hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links and preserves pets safely across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven effective in past winning tests.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Generation Wait Status Info: Display explicit progress status and desktop tip carousel while waiting for pet companion desktop assets to generate. (why: The waiting home step has a long duration (median 201s, mean 2336s), creating user drop-off and potential confusion during pet preparation.)
2: [finish, redesign] Complete Desktop Companion Arrival Redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a stage layout explaining desktop interaction controls clearly before launch. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to control or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout Companion Path Selector: Change the path selection screen layout to a grid format presenting path options visually. (why: choose_path layout edits produced winning tests previously, helping users make fast initial selections (median current time is 8s but mean is 514s).)
4: [home, new_flow] Desktop Spawning Mascot Waiting Flow: Add a animated pet mascot component and desktop ready progress bar to the waiting screen. (why: Past lessons show home new_flow tests perform well, and visual feedback helps reduce drop-off during the long wait step (mean 2336s).)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Account Journey Reorder: Move sign-in to take place after companion pick and photo upload steps so users customize their pet before authenticating. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (63.3%); allowing users to customize their pet first builds ownership before introducing account creation.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Companion Controls Guidance Hint: Add an explicit control hint on the home intro screen detailing tray icon navigation and right-click pet actions. (why: 3 support tickets noted user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their companion once onboarding finishes.)
7: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Photo Quality Prep Screen: Insert a dedicated photo preparation advice screen before upload_photos showing formatting and lighting guidance. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect appearance, pointing to poor photo input quality during adoption.)
